channel.title: BC Arts Grants Weekly Updates
channel.description: New and approaching funding opportunities for artists, arts organizations, and eligible community arts projects in British Columbia.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Literary Arts — BC Arts Council
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Operating support for eligible established B.C. non-profit literary arts organizations and arts periodical publishers.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Professional Arts Training Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Supports established B.C. non-profit organizations providing specialized professional arts training.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Arts & Cultural Service Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Supports eligible B.C. arts and cultural service organizations with an established membership base and provincial impact.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Book Publishers — BC Arts Council
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Operating support for eligible B.C. book publishers developing and promoting Canadian writers.

item.title: Project Assistance: Community Arts Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 14, 2026. Supports eligible B.C. community arts councils and cultural organizations with specific projects or production activities.

item.title: Project Assistance: Media Arts Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 14, 2026. Supports independent media arts works, programming and community-engagement initiatives.

item.title: Project Assistance: Museums and Indigenous Cultural Centres
item.description: Deadline: October 14, 2026. Supports exhibitions, public programs, residencies, collections work and community engagement.

item.title: Project Assistance: Visual Arts Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 14, 2026. Supports new or expanded public programming and community engagement in visual arts and craft.

item.title: Local Festivals — Building Communities Through Arts and Heritage
item.description: Deadline: October 15, 2026. Up to $200,000 for eligible recurring local festivals presenting local arts, heritage and Indigenous cultural activities.

item.title: Professional Arts Festivals and Performing Arts Series Presenters — Canada Arts Presentation Fund
item.description: Deadline: October 15, 2026. Supports eligible professional arts festivals and performing arts series presenters across Canada, including B.C. organizations.

item.title: Support for Organizations — Canada Book Fund
item.description: Intake opens September 21; deadline October 31, 2026. Supports eligible Canadian book-industry organizations with marketing, professional development, internships and technology projects.

item.title: Indigenous Heritage — Museums Assistance Program
item.description: Deadline: November 2, 2026. Supports the preservation, management and presentation of Indigenous cultural heritage.

item.title: Access to Heritage — Museums Assistance Program
item.description: Deadline: November 2, 2026. Supports travelling exhibitions that help heritage organizations reach audiences across Canada.

item.title: Collections Management — Museums Assistance Program
item.description: Deadline: November 2, 2026. Supports professional knowledge, skills and practices for museum collections management.

item.title: Endowment Incentives — Canada Cultural Investment Fund
item.description: Deadline: December 1, 2026. Government matching support for eligible private donations raised for professional arts organizations’ endowment funds.

item.title: Canada Cultural Spaces Fund — Canadian Heritage
item.description: Ongoing while funds remain available. Supports eligible renovations and specialized equipment for arts, heritage and cultural spaces.

item.title: Development — Canada Arts Presentation Fund
item.description: Contact the regional office for the deadline. Supports emerging arts presenters serving under-served communities or artistic practices.

item.title: Exhibition Circulation Fund — Museums Assistance Program
item.description: Ongoing intake. Helps eligible museums host travelling exhibitions or borrow artefacts from federal institutions; available funding is limited.

item.title: Community Climate Action Grant — City of Vancouver
item.description: Deadline: October 1, 2026. Up to $50,000 for community-led climate action; aligned creative public engagement and arts-based approaches may be eligible.

item.title: 2027 Cultural Grants — City of Surrey
item.description: Deadline: October 5, 2026. Open support for Surrey arts, culture and heritage through celebration, project and operating categories.

item.title: 2027 Culture Project Grant — City of Nanaimo
item.description: Deadline: October 6, 2026. Supports culture and heritage projects contributing to Nanaimo’s cultural, social and economic vitality.

item.title: 2027 Culture Operating Grant — City of Nanaimo
item.description: Deadline: October 6, 2026. Annual operating support for qualifying professional arts, culture and heritage non-profits in Nanaimo.

item.title: Individual Arts Grants: Creative Writers — BC Arts Council
item.description: Deadline: October 7, 2026. Project support for professional B.C. writers undertaking specific creative writing projects.

item.title: Circulation and Touring — Canada Council for the Arts
item.description: Deadline: October 7, 2026. Supports circulation and touring of Canadian artists, exhibitions and artistic works.

item.title: Accelerate Program — BC Arts Council
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. A two-year initiative to improve access and reduce funding barriers for equity-deserving and regional arts groups.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Community Arts Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Operating support for organizations providing public access to arts and culture and developing community leadership.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Museums & Indigenous Cultural Centres
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Supports annual public, curatorial and collections programs of eligible museums and Indigenous cultural centres.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Visual & Media Arts Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Operating support for sustained public, artistic and curatorial programs in visual and media arts.
